highPriority.replyText: Hi, thanks for reaching out. Please send me your catalogue and wholesale pricing for 4G routers. We buy around 200 units per month.
highPriority.suggestedReply:
Hi,

Thanks for getting back to us. Happy to share our catalogue and wholesale pricing for our 4G router line.

To put together the right quote, could you confirm a few details:
- Which models or specs are you targeting (band support, port count, Wi-Fi standard)?
- Target monthly volume per model (you mentioned ~200 units/month total)
- Destination country and any certification requirements (CE/FCC etc.)
- Preferred payment terms

We are a manufacturer with stock available, so lead times are typically short. I'll send the catalogue and price list right after your confirmation.

Best regards
highPriority.reasoning: 客户明确索要目录与批发价并给出月采购量，属高意向，需人工接管报价与条款。

highPriority.replyText: Sounds interesting. What's your MOQ and do you have CE certification? Also lead time please.
highPriority.suggestedReply:
Hi,

Thanks for your interest in our routers and networking equipment.

Happy to help with all three points:
- MOQ: we can share tiered MOQs based on model and order volume.
- Certification: our units carry CE (and other relevant certifications depending on model).
- Lead time: stock items ship quickly; exact timing depends on quantity and destination.

Could you let me know which models and approximate quantities you're considering, plus your delivery location? I'll then send a full quote with pricing, MOQ, certification documents and lead time.

Best regards
highPriority.reasoning: 客户明确询问MOQ、CE认证与交期，属具体采购条件，需人工接管。

unsubscribe.replyText: Not interested at this time, please remove me from your list.
unsubscribe.suggestedReply: Understood — we've removed you from our list and you won't receive further messages from us. Apologies for the interruption, and best of luck with your business.
unsubscribe.reasoning: 客户明确要求从名单中移除，属于退订，须立即停止联系并加入抑制名单。

others.replyText: Thanks but we already work with several router brands. We'll keep your details for the future.

No pressure at all — we will stay in touch occasionally. Wishing you a good week ahead.
